title: Austronesian peoples - Wikipedia
text: Johann Friedrich Blumenbach added Austronesians as the fifth category to his "varieties" of humans in the second edition of De Generis Humani Varietate Nativa (1781). He initially grouped them by geography and thus called Austronesians the "people from the southern world".

title: Watut language - Wikipedia
text: Watut is a language complex of Austronesian languages spoken in northern Papua New Guinea. Dialects include Maralinan, Silisili, Unank, Maralangko, and Danggal.

title: Kodut, North Language (UNA) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ...
text: North Kodut is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
